lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: You are the one from the monastery. The Auditor. I am Pell; I keep the gate, or I did before the drone came.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Every night it circles lower. Allocation pattern: counting, deciding. If it decides we need managing, this stops being a free town.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Go up to the gate and break it. I have a prayer wheel that belonged to the founding; it is worth something to a trader. It is yours.
